token_lengths_note: mmBERT tokenizer over rows + gate (9,454 docs): max 3220, p99 1795, median 172; 772 exceed 1024, 0 exceed 4096

recipe.note: laya 0.4.1 train_cli defaults; the pilot (300 rows, 1 epoch) peaked at 19.2 GB with one allocator OOM-retry from the fp32 calibration pass (batch 16), not the training batches, so defaults stand

gate.cutoff_rule: argmax out-of-fold F1, ties to the higher cutoff
gate.precision: TP_w / (flags_w + r * unlabeled_stratum); r = gate-sample flag rate of the all-data model
gate.recall: TP_w / P_w over pool (weight 1) + net sample (weight 5); positives outside pool + net unobserved
gate.caveat: out-of-fold numbers are optimistic (same storm, pre-selected articles); passing earns the 1872 test only

fuzzy_rg.note: v2: shape confusions only; v1 (vowel swaps, spaces between letters) matched 4,915 1859 articles, mostly 'entere(d)', so it was narrowed on unlabeled-text match counts before any labels; v2 matches 599 (strict 584); 1859 numbers are in-sample

answer_key_1872: pool = fine-tuned Laya (t*) + base Laya (0.5, M6 precision rule) + strict rg + fuzzy rg; loose net = freeze/loose.rg, 1-in-N sample with N committed after counting; labelers = Claude Sonnet batches + Gemma gemma4:26b-a4b-it-mtp-q4_K_M via the gateway (temperature 0, loops UNPARSED to adjudication) + blind Claude Opus adjudication of all disagreements plus 30 agreed checks
pass_bar_1872: precision >= 0.80 AND weighted recall >= 0.80 AND at least one sighting strict rg missed

fold_rows.note: training rows per fold; prep_stats.json fold_sizes also count 90 gate articles that share a reprint group with training rows (those are excluded from the gate)
